instances.name: ADC1

requirements: ADC1 only: internal VREFINT is not available through ADC2/ADC3; no GPIO pin or external connection is selected.
Fresh owned startup: ADC1/ADC2/ADC3 initially disabled and no other ADC, timer, DMA or interrupt owner. VDDA/VREF+ supply must satisfy the declared datasheet operating range.
Set CR1=0, CR2=0, SQR1=0 and SQR3.SQ1=17 while disabled; SMP17=7 means 480 ADC clocks. Keep reserved bits zero.
Enable reference/common configuration and ADON|EOCS, then provide at least 10 us reference startup and 3 us ADC power-up settling before SWSTART; the example uses the separate 1 ms TIM2 contract.
Clear stale SR flags with SR=0, issue SWSTART only after settling, bound EOC polling, reject OVR and out-of-range raw values, read DR once, then disable ADC/reference and stop the owned timer.
No scan, external analog input, injected conversion, ADC2/ADC3, DMA, interrupts, calibration, temperature or precision voltage measurement is supported by this contract.

requirements: Requires the declared HSE8/168 MHz system profile, PCLK2=84 MHz and assumed VDDA/VREF+ in 2.7–3.6 V; ADCCLK=21 MHz remains below the 36 MHz datasheet ceiling in this range.
All ADCs must be disabled and unshared before CCR changes. Select MULTI=0, ADCPRE=1, DMA=0, VBATE=0 and TSVREFE=1; keep reserved bits zero.
Allow at least 10 us reference startup and select at least 10 us ADC acquisition; this workflow uses 480 cycles at 21 MHz and a separately implemented 1 ms settling delay.

requirements: Assume HSE8 crystal, internal regulator,2.7-3.6V and exclusive startup ownership; no measured clock or errata certification.
Do not reconfigure an active PLLI2S/CSS or live peripheral owner. Enable/wait HSI, select it and confirm SWS before disabling main PLL.
Install safe APB1/4 and APB2/2 divisors; disable PLL and wait unlocked; disable HSE and confirm not ready before clearing HSEBYP.
Enable/read back PWR gate, establish Scale1/VOSRDY and set/read back FLASH LATENCY5 before increasing HCLK.
Enable/wait HSE; with both PLLs disabled program M8/N336/P2/Q7,HSE source while preserving reserved fields; enable PLL and wait lock.
Select PLL, confirm SWS and divisors, then synchronize SystemCoreClock. Every wait finite; failure stops dependent initialization without claiming a successful clock switch.

instances.name: TIM2

requirements: Exclusive fresh TIM2, no channel/slave/interrupt/DMA owners, declared HSE8 PLL mode and APB1/4; TIM2CLK=2*PCLK1=84 MHz.
Keep CEN=0 and DIER=0 while setting PSC=8399, ARR=9. Write EGR=UG to load PSC/reinitialize counter; write SR=0 afterward to discard the UG-created UIF.
Set CR1=OPM|CEN with UDIS/URS/DIR/CMS/ARPE zero. Poll UIF with a finite budget and verify CEN cleared. This is 1 ms nominal under the declared clock assumptions, not measured timing.
Do not accept the stale UG flag as elapsed time. Stop the owned timer on failure. This operation uses no timer output pin or NVIC interrupt.
